selectedScenarios: All ten previously accepted Petclinic scenarios, unchanged
baseline: Fresh legacy route/direct-reference seeds converted to unique canonical METHOD identities
improved: Same seeds plus unique source-declared calls, breadth first, depth 2, maximum 64 methods per scenario
sharedInputs: Five exact-digest inputs pinned by SfBl002RouteEffectivenessRun plus clean exact source checkout
sharedExtractor: Identical packaged Java runtime JAR SHA256 in both arms

isolation.mechanism: Separate actor contexts and strict producer five-file allowlist; not an OS sandbox

proofRule: Independent reviewer adjudicates source/scenario support after both producer artifacts are sealed; static calls do not prove observed execution
stoppingRule: One paired calibration; no tuning against scored misses; preserve failed/incomplete namespaces
decisionRule: Use frozen Plan thresholds for calibration only; undefined mandatory metrics yield INCONCLUSIVE; integrity failure invalidates comparison
limitations: Exposed calibration, not unseen holdout or statistical generalization
Forward realization only, not Reverse capability discovery
Graphify frozen snapshot reused as context, not newly indexed or call-execution proof
Top-level source declarations only; generic, overloaded, inherited or uncertain identities abstain
